final_message:
I implemented `count_ngrams` in `labkit/model/ngrams.py`, and both tests in `tests.test_c5_ngrams` pass.

It raises `ValueError` if `n < 1`. Otherwise it slides a window of size `n` over the tokens and counts each n-gram as a tuple in a dict. A list shorter than `n` gives an empty dict.
